tests.text: We hold a captured source of theirs (slug and latest capture stamp). Counted only where a capture has status 200 and text of at least 300 bytes; a blocked or failed capture (e.g. the two openai.com blog captures, HTTP 403) does not count. Pages by a third party about them do not count.

Their reporting kept 'unable to verify' or equivalent hedging where it applied (a dated 'as of', a named scope, an attempt not called a compromise). pass true needs cited evidence; 'unknown' when we have none; false when a correction request is open against them (named: id and status), which counts against. Score counts true only.

A published channel, by name. No URL is given because none appears in sources.json or our briefs and none was fetched (outside fetches are barred): every channel is 'url: null, to_confirm: true' and must be found and captured before use. pass false where only a person's handle exists. Never a private address.

scoring: score = number of tests passed (careful counts only when true); sorted by score, then wave (1, 2, 3, none), then id. A score of 3 does not mean 'send': open correction requests make careful false for the publishers they name, and corrections come first (never a correction and an interview to the same party at once; board 332).
